question: Should `tool-progress` become a supported generic Plugin SDK reply-payload contract for producer plugins and channel plugins?
rationale: A typed cross-plugin seam is preferable to Slack inferring intent from text, but making this additive export permanent is a third-party API decision that correctness review cannot authorize.

options.title: Adopt Generic Intent
options.body: Keep the narrow generic progress kind, document its semantics, and require channel implementations to honor it across every rendering path.

options.title: Keep It Internal
options.body: Move the intent behind an internal runtime seam, avoiding public API growth but requiring a different Codex-to-channel ownership path.

options.title: Pause This Direction
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a broader portable progress-presentation model.

recommendation.title: Adopt Generic Intent
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow generic progress kind, document its semantics, and require channel implementations to honor it across every rendering path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Slack native-presentation work and broad Plugin SDK history make this the clearest available owner for the permanent boundary choice.
